title: 5 EXTREME BUDGET $5 DINNERS | Cheap & Easy Family Meals | Julia Pacheco
description:
Trying to feed your family on a really tight grocery budget can be stressful. I understand, and I’ve been there too. 🧡 Today I’m sharing 5 cheap and easy family dinners that each came in under $6 based on the prices I paid at Walmart. Come shop with me, see what made it into my cart, and let’s turn a few affordable ingredients into simple, filling dinners that can help stretch the grocery budget a little further. Thank you so much for watching and for all your support 🌼
